qa_pairs.question: In Ansys Fluent, how do you enable the updating of Discrete Phase Model (DPM) source terms for each flow iteration?
qa_pairs.answer: To enable updating DPM source terms every flow iteration, open the Discrete Phase Model Dialog Box and select "Interaction with Continuous Phase".

qa_pairs.question: After confirming a Discrete Phase Model (DPM) injection in the graphical user interface, how can its setup be automated in an Ansys Fluent journal file after solution initialization?
qa_pairs.answer: Once the injection is confirmed in the GUI, the steps can be automated by adding commands to the journal file after solution initialization, such as `/define/models/dpm/interaction/coupled-calculations yes` to enable coupled calculations, followed by commands like `/define/models/dpm/injections/delete-injection injection-0:1` and `/define/models/dpm/injections/create injection-0:1 no yes file no zinjection01.inj no no no no` to manage the injection.
